text: Artificial Intelligence, or AI, is the ability of computers to do tasks that usually need human intelligence, such as understanding language or making decisions. Machine learning is a part of AI that lets computers learn from data without being told every step. Deep learning, a more advanced type, uses large neural networks to recognise images, speech, and patterns. Today, AI is everywhere in daily life: it recommends films on streaming platforms, helps us unlock phones with our faces, translates languages, and powers virtual assistants like Siri. It also supports doctors in finding diseases earlier.
